messages:
Ashok: Quick heads-up — planning to bump API 0.14 -> 0.15 across runtime, console, and SDKs tomorrow morning. Need merge-window check and short changelog lines. Who can review PRs? cc @Julia @Sam
Julia: I can take console + JS SDK. Plan to open console PR after local e2e passes (should be by 09:30 PT).
Sam: I'll take runtime and API server side. Two asks: (1) confirm swagger change won't break clients, (2) can we freeze release/* branches 30m before deploy?
Marie: Reminder — Dedicated infra has scheduled node maintenance 03:00 UTC tomorrow, please avoid merges 02:30-03:45 UTC.
Ashok: Good catch @Marie. Let's aim to avoid that window. Can we shift the deploy window to avoid maintenance?
release-bot: automated: suggested release window 10:00 PT — create PR checklist and health checks.
Sam: Changelog draft (putting this here so reviewers can copy):
```
- API v0.15 — header normalization: ensure X-Request-Id preserved; small swagger addition for GET /v1/health
- Runtime v0.15 — improved KV-cache eviction for long-context workloads
- Console v0.15 — expose version toggle in settings, minor UI fix for model picker
- JS SDK v0.15 — bump client; preserve backward-compatible auth header parsing
```
Julia: For JS SDK: bump package.json -> 0.15.0, update CHANGELOG.md with the one-liner. I think minor version bump is appropriate.
Lee: I'll handle Docker image tagging + CI updates. Will open runtime container PRs and tag `release/v0.15-api`.
Ashok: Owners noted: Runtime=Sam, Console+JS=Julia, Docker/CI=Lee, Changelog publish=Ashok. Proposed timeline: open PRs by 09:30 PT, review by 11:00 PT, freeze 11:30 PT, deploy 12:00 PT. Anyone object?
Marie: No objections. I'll monitor infra and post if window shifts.
Sam: One quick question — do we need an explicit migration note for clients about header behavior? I propose adding a short snippet in the changelog showing the expected header handling.
Julia: Agreed — include small example in changelog: `curl -H 'X-Request-Id: 123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and mention no change to auth.
Ashok: Perfect. I'll create a checklist gist and post links when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Created release checklist: https://gist.github.com/release-bot/abc123 — will post updates in this thread.
Lee: PRs opened: runtime https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/212, console https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/98, js-sdk https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/54
Ashok: Thanks everyone. I'll ping again once changelog publish is queued. Ping here if anything blocks. :shipit:
